name: get_errors
description:
Request to get errors and warnings from the workspace or specific files. This tool retrieves diagnostics from the language server.

Parameters:
- filePaths: (optional) Array of file paths to check. If not provided, checks all files in the workspace.

Example: Get all errors in workspace
{ }

Example: Get errors in specific files
{ "filePaths": ["src/app.ts", "src/utils.ts"] }

filePaths.description: Array of file paths to check (optional, checks all files if not provided)
